# Windows setup download cache

These unmodified public GitHub CLI and Node.js archives are cached for the
commission setup because GitHub release downloads returned HTTP 502/503 on
the owner computer. Their original license and third-party notice files remain
inside the archives. Exact official URLs, byte counts and SHA-256 digests are
recorded in provenance.json. No signing keys, passwords or Google credentials
are stored here.

The setup verifies the same pinned SHA-256 before extraction and execution.
The cached x64 archives can be downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com.
ARM64 continues to use the official upstream downloads.
